groups.F01: Five live Firebase sign-ins, invalid credentials, logout, reloaded roles, unauthenticated access, role immutability and cross-owner access. New registration tested in isolated Playwright.
groups.F02: 64 public courts and 10 WebP assets, combined search/area/sport/time, address, empty results and unreserved slot preview.
groups.F03: Live detail and local-date availability; AVAILABLE, BOOKED and BLOCKED. FR-013 deferred in PA3.
groups.F04: Single and two consecutive slots, invalid selection, repricing/reconfirmation, competing overlap denial, accepted amount after reload.
groups.F05: History, reload, whole cancellation and release, immutable accepted price, cancellation refused below 6 h.
groups.F06: Browser create/hours/publish batch/maintenance, reload; individual publish/edit/remove maintenance; confirmed booking protected; venue deactivation persisted.
groups.F07: Owner history/detail in browser and authoritative amounts; cross-owner booking/court rejected.
groups.F08: Profile saved/reloaded and verified by API, role cannot be edited, original demo nickname restored.
groups.F09: Manual/automatic activation, schedule cancellation, active deactivation, discounted booking and preserved accepted total. Expired fixtures read through the database.
groups.F10: Discovery, creation, capacity, duplicate and full rejection, 122500 VND estimate, Join/Leave and organizer authorization; explicit/source-cancellation closure.
